title: Psalm 23 Prayer | The Lord Is My Shepherd, Line By Line (KJV)
description:
Psalm 23 prayer: The Lord is my shepherd, read and explained line by line from the King James Bible.

David was a shepherd before he was a king. This walks through every verse of Psalm 23, what it meant to a man who kept sheep, and ends by praying the psalm.

"The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want." Psalm 23:1 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 23:1, Psalm 23:2-3, Psalm 23:4, John 10:11, John 10:27-28, Luke 15:4-5, Psalm 23:5, Psalm 23:6.
